title: Sarah Vaughan and Carmen McRae sing with his trio; records with them
summary: At his Manhattan Beach job, Sarah Vaughan and Carmen McRae sat in, and he made albums with each.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Session players on the hits: "I played on that record"

blocks.x: Then I took this job at the beach, way down on Manhattan Beach with my trio. And about that time, Sarah Vaughan and Carmen McRae moved into town. They weren't doing too much, so they used to come on down all the time an sing with me. And I'd go home to either one of their houses and stay there after work, you know, and talk it up and everything, and raise a lot of heck -- and I wound up making some records with them. I made "The Great American Songbook" with Carmen, and I made a record with Sass, Sarah, "Sarah Vaughan with Jimmy Rowles' Rhythm Section." I don't think they made too many pressings on that one.
